title: MC Cards OG Pack Textures
description: Changes the OG MC Cards card pack textures back to the OG ones
body: Changes the MC Cards card pack textures back to the original textures that were blocks instead of mobs. Only changes the Common, Uncommon, Rare, Nether, and End Card Packs as well as there Mega Box versions.![Common Card Pack With OG Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/459285ebc51c661d71fb7cba5535411163f8723c.png) ![Rare Card Pack With OG Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09d80c0c571e2f307d72dc72a6bb3918216b29c7.png)
